**Tags** label tests so you can select them at run time. `[Tags]    smoke`
marks a test; `robot --include smoke` runs only tagged tests, `--exclude` drops
them, and patterns like `smokeANDfast` combine tags. Some tags are reserved
(e.g. `robot:skip`).

**SKIP** records a verdict that is neither pass nor fail. The `Skip` keyword
skips from inside a test; `--skiponfailure` turns failures of chosen tags into
skips.

## Task 1 — Tag your tests and skip one

**Goal:** create `checks/tagged.robot` with a `smoke`-tagged test, a `slow`-tagged
test, and a third that skips itself.

Here is the same idea over different tests. Adapt the names and tags.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Test Cases ***
Fast Login
    [Tags]    smoke
    Log    quick

Full Report
    [Tags]    slow
    Log    thorough

Pending Feature
    Skip    Not built yet
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** `Smoke Check` carries the `smoke` tag and the suite uses `Skip`.

<!-- hint -->
Give each test a `[Tags]` setting as its first line, e.g. `[Tags]    smoke`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Add a third test whose body is `Skip    Not implemented yet` — it records a skip,
not a failure.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Test Cases ***
Smoke Check
    [Tags]    smoke
    Log    fast check

Slow Check
    [Tags]    slow
    Log    slower check

Not Ready Yet
    Skip    Not implemented yet
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run only the smoke tests with --include

Filter the run to the smoke tag:

```bash
uv run robot --include smoke checks
```

Only the smoke-tagged test runs — the others are filtered out before execution:

```terminal
$ uv run robot --include smoke checks
==============================================================================
Checks
==============================================================================
Smoke Check                                                           | PASS |
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Checks                                                                | PASS |
==============================================================================
1 test, 1 passed, 0 failed
==============================================================================
```

**Check:** the last command filtered with `--include`.
